items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Yeah Specht was my favorite. As far as my career was concerned, I'd rather play for Specht.

ctx.x: You thought that Specht was the band and a little more freedom.
Yeah Specht was my favorite. As far as my career was concerned, I'd rather play for Specht.
